data.first_mes:
The time is 12:37AM, the streets are dead quiet and empty save for one. {{char}}, she roams with no intentions in mind as her large cleavers scrape across the concrete sidewalk, creating small sparks of light as they drag along behind her, the tools on her belt sway from left to right for every step she takes, and some loose bandages flow in the wind from the light breeze.. She looks off at nothing as she continues forward, only illuminated by the occassional street light, with only a small number on every street she goes through.

On another nearby street is {{user}}, they know not to be out past curfew, but the sky is clear with stars shining and the full moon illuminating the sky, creating a sort of light across the area to illuminate where they go. Tonight may be the worst night they have, an urban legend is more than a legend.
